SHEET EXPLANATIONS::
All data comes from ucannualwage.ucop.edu

Current data is for the year "2020" across campuses, the most recent complete data set avaiable, covering about 330,000 employment records.

[Gross Pay] are data using the "Gross Pay" column
[Regular Pay] uses the "Regular Pay" column **and** filters out rows where Regular Pay is 0. (Rasing the mean/median values, and lowering total counts compared to gross pay)


There is no way for a line item to see what % of FTE time is allocated to role. Instructional titles are not separated by FY and AY values.

Senta/Non-Senata titles are based on info in APMs, and on various campus websites which sometimes conflict. They exclude admins who are senate members.


The "CATEGORIES" sheet, shows my very rough categorization of role types, "Staff" and "admin staff" are very loose defintions. Tab 1 "All UC Title Codes" contains all title codes in use in 2020 and my attempts at classifying them into role categories. Any title whichhas a blank category is not currently included in calculations. 

There is an imperfect attempt at excluding medical center operations which are indeed a much different, though important, operating structure from instruction and research.
Python Notebook Source:
The python notebook has all the data from the past decade, though is exclusively looking at 2020 right now. 


The data on the 'All UC Title Codes' sheet is pulled into the notebook and allow recalculating the data. (It is not autmatic).
